note: Every candidate is an in-house mechanism in the-boss or the mini, not a third-party library. Tiers 2-4 of the research pipeline were not needed and not spent. Each 'adopt' means: use this existing code, do not rebuild it.

candidates.gap: Ship the mini's 22 skills inside the-boss on every platform
candidates.evidence: Runs on every startup from AiService.ts:407. Copies resources/skills/* into {userData}/Data/Skills/, registers in DB, mirrors into CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills. Updates gated on computeBuiltinDirectoryHash (SkillService.ts:1142), NOT a version string, so the 21 mini skills without `version:` are fine. The `namespace` parameter exists at :1123 with ownership guards at :1127-1137 but builtinSkills.ts:53 never passes it.
candidates.work_required: Pass a namespace. No new installer.

candidates.gap: Keep resources/skills/ in sync with the mini submodule
candidates.evidence: Existing precedent for tracked-but-generated files: --check fails CI when an output is missing or stale. resources/skills/ is git-tracked (hand-authored commits), so making it generated-and-ignored would change how the-boss's own 5 skills are managed — out of scope.
candidates.work_required: scripts/sync-mini-skills.ts with the same --check mode. Exclude skills/carried-payload.test.mjs and skills/AGENTS.md.

candidates.gap: Ship compass and rust-mcp-filesystem binaries per platform
candidates.evidence: Already ships mise, bun, uv, rg, mingit keyed platform-arch with SHA-256, a cross-worktree hard-linked cache, and verifyBundledBinaries(). Manifest fields: name, version, versionFile, required, packages, isWindowsOnly; per-package url, archive, binaries, sha256, strip, dir. compass-release.yml:106-132 emits compass-<target>.tar.gz plus a .sha256 sidecar extracting to compass-<target>/ — a direct field-for-field fit.
candidates.work_required: Two TOOLS entries plus hashes. Blocked on cand-008.

candidates.gap: Register bundled binaries as MCP servers that resolve on Windows
candidates.evidence: Returns resolution: 'system' | 'bundled' | 'unresolved' with unavailableReason. getBinaryName appends .exe on win32 (:15-17); getBinaryPath searches mise shims then cherry.bin (pathRegistry.ts:66). The Runner abstraction's notFound message is the established pattern for 'bundled binary missing'.
candidates.work_required: Register compass as a stdio server, stdio transport only.

candidates.gap: Run the mini's doctor from the UI and render results progressively
candidates.evidence: Verified incremental publish at DoctorService.ts:298-301: execute() takes a callback that republishes partial results. Progress travels via a shared cache key (doctorStateCacheKey), NOT IPC; the renderer subscribes with useSharedCacheValue/useSyncExternalStore. Cancellation is AbortController-based. UI exists: DoctorChecksPanel.tsx, DoctorDialog.tsx. Failure path at :332-336 documents the must-publish-a-terminal-state rule.
candidates.work_required: One check-source spawning scripts/doctor.mjs, mapping JSON lines per lib/doctor/contract.md. Largest scope reduction in the phase.

candidates.evidence: preferenceSchemas.ts header states it is auto-generated from classification.json — editing it directly is silently reverted by the next pnpm data:generate. preferenceTable is (scope, key, value JSON) with a composite PK, so NO Drizzle migration is needed for new keys. Key convention namespace.sub.key_name, ESLint-enforced, and deliberately different from the i18n convention.
candidates.work_required: Add keys to classification.json, regenerate. Read via usePreference.

candidates.gap: Internationalized labels for the settings section
candidates.evidence: 13 locales, 5720 keys in en-us. Catalogs are FLAT (keySeparator: false). ci:basic-check runs i18n:check && i18n:unused:check && i18n:hardcoded:strict; i18n:check throws on a missing key, an EXTRA key, or a non-string value. pnpm i18n:sync propagates.
candidates.work_required: Keys in all 13 locales, in the same change as the components, or CI fails.
candidates.risk: Most likely cause of a late build failure.

candidates.candidate: existing release workflows on the forks
candidates.source: GQAdonis/compass compass-release.yml; GQAdonis/rust-mcp-filesystem cargo-dist release.yml; Prometheus-AGS/openspec release-prepare.yml
candidates.evidence: All three have working workflows. All three have ZERO releases — never run. compass is the most mature (contract tests, licence checks, provenance attestation, both Windows arches). rust-mcp-filesystem gained aarch64-pc-windows-msvc in PR GQAdonis/rust-mcp-filesystem#1.
candidates.work_required: Operator tags and runs. Confidence is medium precisely because none has executed.

candidates.source: operator-supplied URL; verified via gh api
candidates.evidence: Rust workspace with crates/, Cargo.toml, SKILL.md, claude-plugin.json. NO .github/workflows at all and 0 releases. isFork: false, last pushed 2026-07-02. Unlike the other three it cannot be 'tagged and released' — CI must be built first. Matches the four blockers in the mini's sycophancy-correction-vendored change.
candidates.work_required: Fork/transfer, then build release CI from scratch, then the four Windows fixes.
candidates.risk: Long pole of goal A. Sequence first or defer.

candidates.gap: Docker detection for the three services
candidates.evidence: Specified as dockerState() -> { state: 'absent' | 'daemon-down' | 'ready', client, server } via spawnExecutable('docker', ['version', '--format', '{{json .}}']), with no wsl.exe, no socket access, no dependency. the-boss has NO Docker awareness today (6 incidental mentions). Boundary: the mini probes, the-boss renders and owns consent.
candidates.work_required: the-boss spawns the mini's services.mjs; builds only the UI and the consent preference.
candidates.risk: docker.mjs does not exist yet — change docker-services creates it. Confidence medium for that reason.

candidates.evidence: SettingsContentColumn, SettingGroup, SettingRow, SettingRowTitle, SettingDivider, SettingHelpText. Library is a local workspace package (Radix + Tailwind, vendored shadcn-style) — NOT antd, NOT a stock shadcn install. Three registries per section: route file, settingsMenu.ts (hand-maintained, order = render order), *.search.ts (auto-globbed).
candidates.work_required: Compose within the existing vocabulary. The four design skills govern information architecture, state design and copy — not component choice; introducing a second component vocabulary would be a defect, not better design.

candidates.gap: The mini vendors compass, rust-mcp-filesystem, openspec and sycophancy-correction as SOURCE (goal B4)
candidates.candidate: git submodules under tools/ in the mini, pinned to released commits
candidates.evidence: Distinct from cand-003, which is how the-boss consumes ARTIFACTS. The mini needs the source: its sycophancy resolver searches tools/sycophancy-correction/target/release/ "for developer checkouts", mini-submodules verifies each vendored submodule is BUILT (tools/openspec/dist, tools/prometheus-knowledge/target/release/pk), and versions.toml pins each gitlink by commit. Without the submodules those checks have nothing to point at.
candidates.work_required: Four git submodule adds in the mini, pinned to the commits cand-008 releases. Then versions.toml entries (operator-authored).
candidates.note: compass and rust-mcp-filesystem are vendored TWICE, differently: source in the mini, binaries in the-boss. Not a choice between the two.

candidates.gap: One-click repair from the settings UI (goal D-12)
candidates.candidate: DoctorFixAction + confirm_check, driven back to doctor.mjs --fix
candidates.evidence: the-boss already models repair: a check declares actions:[{kind:"fix",fixId}] with a fixes handler, and diagnostics.doctor.confirm_check exists alongside run. The mini already emits the action — mini-skill-copies is the one check offering copy-skills — and contract.md specifies the mapping, including refused -> {status:"failed",message} for which the host has no native equivalent.
candidates.work_required: Map our actions onto DoctorFixAction; route the host fix handler to `node scripts/doctor.mjs --fix copy-skills`.
candidates.risk: A-11: that fix writes under the user home directory and refuses on a full-pack machine. The mini enforces this; the UI must not offer a path around it.

candidates.gap: Every-startup push of the skills to the OS home directories, with a visible notice (goal D-13)
candidates.candidate: A lifecycle service chained after reconcileSkills(), reusing the mini copy-skills operation
candidates.source: the-boss: src/main/ai/AiService.ts:407 (where installBuiltinSkills is already chained); mini: lib/doctor/skills.mjs
candidates.evidence: DISTINCT from cand-013. cand-013 is on-demand repair a user clicks in settings; this runs unattended on every boot, copies when absent or differing, and shows a non-modal notice while it runs. installBuiltinSkills() already demonstrates the chaining point and the every-startup cadence, but it writes to {userData}/Data/Skills — never to the user home. Nothing in the-boss writes to the home skills roots today; discovery is import-only.
candidates.work_required: A new lifecycle service (never in main.ts) chained after reconcileSkills(); the copy itself delegates to the mini rather than being reimplemented. Plus the notice UI and the on/off preference (goal D-9).
candidates.risk: A-11 and the binding install-scope rule: on a machine where detectFullPack() reports the full pack present the push is SKIPPED ENTIRELY with a persistent notice saying why. This development machine is exactly that case — 42 mini skill copies already sit beside a full-pack install. An unattended startup task that wrote there would violate openspec/config.yaml.

candidates.gap: The openspec fork as a the-boss submodule (goal B6)
candidates.candidate: Prometheus-AGS/openspec vendored as source, not consumed as a release artifact
candidates.evidence: The exception to cand-003. openspec is Node, it is a build/dev dependency rather than a shipped runtime binary, and it is the source of the Windows-compatibility fixes that make the pack work on Windows at all — so the-boss vendors the source and runs it, rather than downloading a built archive. It is also listed in cand-008 as having a release workflow that has never run, which is about publishing the package, not about how the-boss consumes it.
candidates.work_required: git submodule in the-boss pinned to a released commit; spawn its resolved JS entry through Node, never a .cmd shim.
candidates.risk: Confidence is medium because the consuming call sites in the-boss have not been inventoried — only that the fork exists and is Node.

build_required.gap: The every-startup home-directory push AND its on-demand repair — two behaviours, not one
build_required.rationale: Nothing in the-boss writes to the user home skills directories; discovery is import-only. Goal D-13 needs BOTH: an unattended every-startup push with a notice (cand-014) and the one-click repair a user triggers from settings (cand-013). An earlier draft of this file collapsed them into the repair path alone, which would have let a plan ship settings with no startup behaviour at all. The copy operation itself is the mini copy-skills fix — copy never symlink, refuse beside a full pack, path-escape guarded, mutation-tested — so neither path reimplements it.
build_required.note: the-boss's own scripts/skills-sync.ts symlinks .agents -> .claude, but those are REPO-ROOT developer directories, not the user's home. Different target, no conflict.

build_required.gap: Prometheus settings page, health panel, doctor view and push notice
build_required.rationale: No such section exists. Composed from cand-011 primitives, driven by cand-005/006/007.
See cand-009 — the only one of the four with no workflows at all.
